reserveReview.rationale: Observed at 2026-10-10T23:30:07Z, the October 10 dashboard SSR exposes complete snapshot 6aca28ebd0910f63de3d75e2 at 2026-10-10T12:00:44.591Z. Gross FBO assets are $1,007,270.58: nine positive Treasury-bill CUSIPs sum to $356,316.31, two positive repo positions sum to $600,000 and cash is $50,954.27; category totals and the full positive position roster reconcile exactly. Percentages use gross inventory rounded to two decimals, totaling 100. The separately disclosed $39,218.73 due-to-administration deduction yields net trust reserves $968,051.85, matching displayed liabilities, and is not silently assigned to an asset category. The exact eight native deployment identities match the catalog; the dashboard supply is not a replacement for canonical circulating supply. Verified means the public inventory and arithmetic were independently checked, not that financial assurance was obtained. The dashboard expressly describes all metrics outside issued AT-C 205 reports as supplemental, non-assured and not FRNT's system of record. Its latest report endpoint returned HTTP 403; inaccessible report content is unresolved, not issuer non-disclosure. No signed current financial report was retrieved and the statutory 102% target is not asserted as measured coverage. Latest observed bill maturity is November 24, 45 calendar days after the snapshot date; this observation is not a contractual maturity maximum. The current repo roster matures October 13, not one day after this snapshot; the existing overnight category label is not a current settlement promise. Liquidity horizons remain unknown because holdings do not prove whole-position stressed access or final-cash deadlines. Existing custody review is unchanged. The existing October 9 classification review independently retrieved reserve rules effective September 23, 2026: Chapter 3 section 4(b)(iii), page 3-3, permits only U.S. Treasury security repurchase agreements with a term of thirty days or less. The legal repo maximum of 30 days is preserved without renewing its governing-source review: this lane's retrieval of the Commission rules and manager page failed certificate verification. Cash deposit contractual maturity, repo and cash counterparties, subcustody and reuse protections remain unestablished.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Commission names Fiduciary Trust International as holder-benefit trustee/custodian and Franklin Advisers as portfolio manager. Chapter 3 requires FBO trust accounts separate from liquidity and administration accounts; Chapter 2 limits the special obligation to trust assets. Complete subcustodian agreements, current counterparty allocation, reuse restrictions and custody replacement mechanics were not retrieved, so whole-book institutional custody is not asserted. This is no state full-faith-and-credit or deposit-insurance guarantee.
